answer: Require a slashable bond tied to correlated behavior: each agent locks stake, and when clustering detects a shared timing ripple, a common payout thread, or copied output across accounts, the whole cluster's bonds burn. One honest operator keeps its single stake at the zenith of its reputation; a sybil farm pulling the same thread across a hundred accounts forfeits all hundred bonds at the first correlation flag. Attacks cost real capital that evaporates on detection.
